mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(created_time, 'MM-DD') as date, ROUND( AVG( CASE WHEN ( COALESCE(NULLIF(value_pass, ''), '0')::integer + COALESCE(NULLIF(value_not_pass, ''), '0')::integer ) > 0 THEN ( COALESCE(NULLIF(value_pass, ''), '0')::integer * 100.0 / ( COALESCE(NULLIF(value_pass, ''), '0')::integer + COALESCE(NULLIF(value_not_pass, ''), '0')::integer ) ) ELSE 0 END )::numeric , 1) as lod_score, ROUND( AVG( CASE WHEN ( COALESCE(NULLIF(value_pass, ''), '0')::integer + COALESCE(NULLIF(value_not_pass, ''), '0')::integer ) > 0 THEN ( COALESCE(NULLIF(value_pass, ''), '0')::integer * 100.0 / ( COALESCE(NULLIF(value_pass, ''), '0')::integer + COALESCE(NULLIF(value_not_pass, ''), '0')::integer ) ) ELSE 0 END )::numeric , 1) as loi_score FROM sp_revit_lod WHERE stream_id = #{streamId} AND created_time >= #{startDate} AND created_time <= #{endDate} GROUP BY TO_CHAR(created_time, 'MM-DD'), DATE(created_time) ORDER BY DATE(created_time)

SELECT '第' || EXTRACT(WEEK FROM c."createdAt") || '周' as week_label, EXTRACT(WEEK FROM c."createdAt") as week_num, COUNT(*) as count FROM commits c JOIN branch_commits bc ON c.id = bc."commitId" JOIN branches b ON bc."branchId" = b.id WHERE b."streamId" = #{streamId} AND c."createdAt" >= #{startDate} AND c."createdAt" <= #{endDate} GROUP BY EXTRACT(WEEK FROM c."createdAt") ORDER BY EXTRACT(WEEK FROM c."createdAt")

SELECT b."streamId" as stream_id, b.id as branch_id, b.name as name, (SELECT c2.id FROM commits c2 JOIN branch_commits bc2 ON c2.id = bc2."commitId" WHERE bc2."branchId" = b.id ORDER BY c2."createdAt" DESC LIMIT 1) as latest_commit_id, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) as change_num, COALESCE((SELECT SUM( CASE WHEN cd.data IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_exists(cd.data::jsonb, 'collisions') THEN jsonb_array_length(cd.data::jsonb->'collisions') ELSE 0 END ) FROM sp_crash_detection cd WHERE cd.stream_id = b."streamId" AND cd.modify_time >= #{startDate} AND cd.modify_time <= #{endDate}), 0) as unresolve FROM branches b JOIN branch_commits bc ON b.id = bc."branchId" JOIN commits c ON bc."commitId" = c.id WHERE b."streamId" = #{streamId} AND c."createdAt" >= #{startDate} AND c."createdAt" <= #{endDate} GROUP BY b.id, b."streamId", b.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) > 0 ORDER BY change_num DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT '第' || EXTRACT(WEEK FROM c."createdAt") || '周' as week_label, EXTRACT(WEEK FROM c."createdAt") as week_num, COUNT(*) as commit_count, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(c."totalChildrenCount", 0))::numeric, 1) as avg_children_count FROM commits c JOIN branch_commits bc ON c.id = bc."commitId" JOIN branches b ON bc."branchId" = b.id WHERE b."streamId" = #{streamId} AND c."createdAt" >= #{startDate} AND c."createdAt" <= #{endDate} GROUP BY EXTRACT(WEEK FROM c."createdAt") ORDER BY EXTRACT(WEEK FROM c."createdAt")

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(value_pass, ''), '0')::integer), 0) as total_pass, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(value_not_pass, ''), '0')::integer), 0) as total_not_pass, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(value_pass, ''), '0')::integer), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(value_not_pass, ''), '0')::integer), 0) > 0 THEN ROUND( ( COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(value_pass, ''), '0')::integer), 0) * 100.0 / ( COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(value_pass, ''), '0')::integer), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(NULLIF(value_not_pass, ''), '0')::integer), 0) ) )::numeric , 0) ELSE 0 END as score FROM sp_revit_lod WHERE stream_id = #{streamId} AND created_time >= #{startDate} AND created_time <= #{endDate}

SELECT ROUND( AVG( CASE WHEN ( COALESCE(NULLIF(value_pass, ''), '0')::integer + COALESCE(NULLIF(value_not_pass, ''), '0')::integer ) > 0 THEN ( COALESCE(NULLIF(value_pass, ''), '0')::integer * 100.0 / ( COALESCE(NULLIF(value_pass, ''), '0')::integer + COALESCE(NULLIF(value_not_pass, ''), '0')::integer ) ) ELSE 0 END )::numeric , 1) as lod_score, ROUND( AVG( CASE WHEN ( COALESCE(NULLIF(value_pass, ''), '0')::integer + COALESCE(NULLIF(value_not_pass, ''), '0')::integer ) > 0 THEN ( COALESCE(NULLIF(value_pass, ''), '0')::integer * 100.0 / ( COALESCE(NULLIF(value_pass, ''), '0')::integer + COALESCE(NULLIF(value_not_pass, ''), '0')::integer ) ) ELSE 0 END )::numeric , 1) as loi_score FROM sp_revit_lod WHERE stream_id = #{streamId} AND created_time >= #{startDate} AND created_time <= #{endDate}
